abilities.description: 用于持久化、可复用 UI 的 MCP Apps 引擎。AI 基于轻量级 `window.oma` API 生成单文件 HTML 应用（如待办看板、习惯打卡器、仪表盘、阅读清单），将其保存到注册表，后续可在任何聊天中按名称重新打开。数据存储在由 SQLite 及仅追加变更日志支持的通用集合中，生命周期超出单次会话，AI 与人类协同编辑同一数据源；每次修改均为具备乐观并发控制的幂等命令。内置包含 22 个应用的应用商店，支持实时预览与一键安装。共 33 个工具。传输协议：stdio。认证方式：无需认证（本地运行）。支持注册至 Claude Desktop、Claude Code 和 Codex；应用可在任何支持 MCP Apps 的宿主环境（claude.ai、Claude Desktop、Codex、ChatGPT）中渲染。要求 Node 22+。安装命令：`npx -y @2nd1st/open-mcp-apps`。开源协议：MIT。托管版本地址：https://openmcp.app。

en.name: 2nd1st/open-mcp-apps
en.description: MCP Apps engine for persistent, reusable UI. The AI writes a single-file HTML app — todo board, habit tracker, dashboard, reading list — against a small `window.oma` API, saves it to a registry, and reopens it by name in any later chat. Data lives in generic collections backed by SQLite plus an append-only change ledger, so it outlives the conversation and the AI and the human edit the same store; every mutation is an idempotent command with optimistic concurrency. Ships a 22-app App Store with live previews and one-click install. 33 tools. Transport: stdio. Auth: none (runs locally). Registers into Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and Codex; apps render in any MCP Apps-capable host (claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Codex, ChatGPT). Requires Node 22+. Install: `npx -y @2nd1st/open-mcp-apps`. License: MIT. Hosted version at https://openmcp.app.

abilities.name: ashishsinha1602/schemagate
abilities.description: 面向 Text-to-SQL 智能体的权限感知 Schema 访问工具：挑选问题所需的少量表，并在模型查看 Schema 之前移除调用方角色无权读取的所有表和列；`run_query` 也会拦截这些未经授权的查询（包含带引号、中括号、逗号连接以及 `SELECT *`）。可选哈希链和 ML-DSA-65 签名的审计日志。支持 Postgres、Oracle、MySQL、SQL Server、SQLite。一键 uv 安装：`uvx --from "schemagate[mcp]" schemagate-mcp --url demo`（`demo` 运行内置示例 Schema）；连接数据库时需设置 `SCHEMAGATE_DATABASE_URL` 并添加对应驱动额外依赖，例如 `schemagate[mcp,postgres]`。传输协议：stdio 和流式 HTTP。MCP 层无需认证；数据库凭据包含在 URL 中。公共演示端点（示例 Schema，无需认证）：`https://147-224-254-131.sslip.io/mcp`。提供 7 个工具：select_schema、list_objects、describe_object、run_query、answer、refresh_catalog、health。支持客户端：Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code。Apache-2.0 许可。官方 MCP Registry ID：`io.github.ashishsinha1602/schemagate`。

zh.name: ashishsinha1602/schemagate
zh.description: 面向 Text-to-SQL 智能体的权限感知 Schema 访问工具：挑选问题所需的少量表，并在模型查看 Schema 之前移除调用方角色无权读取的所有表和列；`run_query` 也会拦截这些未经授权的查询（包含带引号、中括号、逗号连接以及 `SELECT *`）。可选哈希链和 ML-DSA-65 签名的审计日志。支持 Postgres、Oracle、MySQL、SQL Server、SQLite。一键 uv 安装：`uvx --from "schemagate[mcp]" schemagate-mcp --url demo`（`demo` 运行内置示例 Schema）；连接数据库时需设置 `SCHEMAGATE_DATABASE_URL` 并添加对应驱动额外依赖，例如 `schemagate[mcp,postgres]`。传输协议：stdio 和流式 HTTP。MCP 层无需认证；数据库凭据包含在 URL 中。公共演示端点（示例 Schema，无需认证）：`https://147-224-254-131.sslip.io/mcp`。提供 7 个工具：select_schema、list_objects、describe_object、run_query、answer、refresh_catalog、health。支持客户端：Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code。Apache-2.0 许可。官方 MCP Registry ID：`io.github.ashishsinha1602/schemagate`。

en.name: ashishsinha1602/schemagate
en.description: Permission-aware schema access for text-to-SQL agents: picks the few tables a question needs and removes every table and column the caller's roles may not read before the model sees the schema; `run_query` also refuses them (quoted, bracketed, comma joins, `SELECT *`). Optional hash-chained, ML-DSA-65-signed audit log. Postgres, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite. Install: one line with uv, `uvx --from "schemagate[mcp]" schemagate-mcp --url demo` (`demo` runs a built-in sample schema); for a database set `SCHEMAGATE_DATABASE_URL` and add its driver extra, e.g. `schemagate[mcp,postgres]`. Transport: stdio and streamable HTTP. Auth: none at the MCP layer; database credentials in the URL. Public demo endpoint (sample schema, no auth): `https://147-224-254-131.sslip.io/mcp`. Tools (7): select_schema, list_objects, describe_object, run_query, answer, refresh_catalog, health. Clients: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code. License: Apache-2.0. Official MCP Registry id `io.github.ashishsinha1602/schemagate`.
